title: Migrate fully registered runtime-derived OpenAPI paths to reviewed references

phases.objective: Replace an existing inline Support Ticket runtime-derived path item with its reviewed registry reference only when the complete path and every method are source-bound, fully registered, and structurally safe to remove.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the precise registry writer against root OpenAPI fixtures that contain fully registered runtime-derived inline Support Ticket paths.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The complete inline path becomes the exact reviewed local path-item reference, check mode is idempotent, and any partial, altered, or path-level-augmented contract remains blocked without mutation.
steps: Create root OpenAPI fixtures with precise runtime-derived Support Ticket operations.
Register the exact methods and paths to reviewed local path-item references.
Verify source, authorization profile, security alternatives, operation identity, response presence, and consequential classification.
Remove each complete eligible inline path block and compose the reviewed reference without reformatting unrelated paths.
Run check mode and then submit altered-operation and path-level-augmented variants to prove fail-closed behavior.
assertions: Only paths whose complete method set equals the registry method set are replaceable.
Every replaceable registry entry is sourced from routes/supportTicketRoutes.js and maps to the same path-item reference.

Every current operation has canonical runtime provenance, recognized authorization metadata, matching security, a generated operation identity, responses, and the generator consequential classification.
Path-level keys, missing methods, extra methods, changed operation identities, wrong sources, wrong security, and partial registration remain conflicts.
The governed writer reports the number and identities of runtime-derived registry paths replaced on the exact eligible PR head.
A second check reports no drift and every unsafe case leaves the source document unchanged.
The Support Ticket runtime integration fixture preserves unrelated contracts while exercising the reviewed-reference replacement through the primary runtime sync flow.

phases.objective: Remove the compatibility migration once every supported root OpenAPI branch uses reviewed registry references.
Detect registry and root-path drift without widening replacement authority beyond complete source-bound Support Ticket paths.
This repository-only OpenAPI composition repair has no external canary target.
Production deployment and runtime verification remain outside this repository-only contract migration.
